# Overall Project Summary: July 18, 2026

Development on July 18 focused on stabilizing cloud-based voice sessions and hardening operational security, with significant progress made in reducing real-time latency and improving CI/CD reliability. The team is currently addressing critical memory exhaustion issues during snapshot hydration and resolving persistent failures in the nightly E2E test suite.

## 🚨 Needs Attention 
- **[elizaos/eliza#16639](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16639) Snapshot Hydration Memory**: Production workers are exhausting heap memory; requires implementation of bounded hydration and streaming raw-byte budgets.
- **[elizaos/eliza#13681](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13681) Nightly App Live E2E**: The desktop-packaged lane is failing; team needs to achieve "three consecutive green" runs to stabilize the build.
- **[elizaos/eliza#16613](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16613) Plugin-Wallet Simulation**: Requires community input on the scope of dry-run systems versus mainnet simulation for transaction modes.

## ✅ Completed Work

### Cloud Voice & Real-time Optimization
*   Reduced latency and improved voice turn accuracy by pre-warming tenancy contexts, capping server buffers, and adjusting EOT thresholds ([elizaos/eliza#16607](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16607), [elizaos/eliza#16606](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16606), [elizaos/eliza#16615](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16615), [elizaos/eliza#16595](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16595)).
*   Enhanced session continuity with streamlined recovery and fallback mechanisms for voice disconnects ([elizaos/eliza#16636](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16636), [elizaos/eliza#16628](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16628), [elizaos/eliza#16627](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16627)).

### Security & Operational Hardening
*   Implemented a two-phase confirmation gate for destructive shell operations to prevent data loss ([elizaos/eliza#16572](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16572)).
*   Improved agent session persistence and runtime startup reliability across restarts ([elizaos/eliza#16620](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16620), [elizaos/eliza#16590](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16590), [elizaos/eliza#16598](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16598), [elizaos/eliza#16574](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16574)).

### CI/CD & Infrastructure
*   Resolved CI failures by aligning Claude review models and fixing linting drifts ([elizaos/eliza#16612](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16612), [elizaos/eliza#16611](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16611), [elizaos/eliza#16587](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16587)).
*   Increased workflow safety by implementing security advisory gates for PRs ([elizaos/eliza#16569](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16569)).
